control_result.scope: Exact pure helper excerpts, authored geometry only; no original wx import or rendered UI
control_result.note: Out-of-range input demonstrates missing validation, not proof a production adapter supplies it

findings: Layout omits nodes based on max_depth, pixel rounding, margin/padding and remaining rectangle dimensions. Treemap rendering is not a completeness audit of source records.
split_box integer rounding can return None,None for a nonzero subpixel fraction, hiding both returned boxes; reproduced. Normal largest-first layout may constrain when this arises.
split_box lacks range/finite validation; authored fraction1.2 returns negative-width tail. Reproduced helper behavior only; no claim real adapter supplies this input.
DrawBox max_depth uses truthiness, so zero does not enforce depth0. Layout passes depth+1 from DrawBox and again into DrawBox, making displayed depth differ from tree-edge count. Static finding.

HotMapNavigator.findNode compares equality, rather than object identity, selecting first equal node; repeated/equal-value nodes are ambiguous. NodeToIndex in listviews used identity instead. Static finding.
SetSelected accepts propagate but always posts event for truthy node, while SetHighlight honors propagate. Falsey node values suppress activation/highlight. Static finding.
DefaultAdapter.overall sums child values rather than using node.size, so empty share is always zero for default adapter. This is adapter semantics, not measured CPU/memory ownership.

TestApp filesystem walker skips symlinks but has no traversal error reporting, snapshot stability or recursion budget. No demo walk or UI launched. Python2 syntax/wx legacy APIs remain runtime-unqualified.
